items.prompt: A trade dictionary has no fee_cents key. What does trade.get("fee_cents") return?

options.text: The known financial fee value zero
options.why: No contract has declared that a missing fee is zero.

options.text: None, unless a different default was supplied
options.why: get uses None as its omitted default.
Direct indexing raises; get has a default path.

options.text: The string fee_cents, as a field placeholder
options.why: get returns a value/default, not the key name.

items.explanation: The missing-key default is None. It signals that no fee value was retrieved; it does not establish a financial zero.
